sample_requests: Run cell segmentation with InstanSeg + NuLite cell typing on this lung H&E slide; show me per-cell density and type composition.
用 LazySlide 跑 cell-level 分割，instanseg 模型，给我每个细胞的多边形 + 报告

smoke_commands.name: lazyslide_seg_imports
smoke_commands.command: ${PYTHON} -c "import lazyslide as zs; assert callable(zs.seg.cells); assert callable(zs.seg.cell_types); assert callable(zs.seg.tissue); print('seg OK')"
